# Isaiah Chapter 57 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 21 verses]*

*Righteous perish unnoticed; idolatry exposed; God with the contrite; peace for far and near; no peace for wicked*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** Peace, peace, to the far and to the near, says the LORD, and I will heal him. This chapter righteous perish unnoticed.

*-- LOGOS*
